## Nightly execution prune

n8n stores the full data of every execution - about 250 KB per Jessie turn.
On 2026-09-02 and again on 2026-09-03 the SQLite database reached roughly
750 MB across 4,161 executions and **both Jessie and Posty stopped receiving
Slack events**. Toggling the workflows active did nothing, many times over.
Deleting 3,781 old executions brought both back.

Runs 04:00 Asia/Manila, off-peak, because the deletes hit the same SQLite
file a booking would be writing to.

### Reading the run
`List Executions` returns **one item per page**, not one per execution - two
items means two pages of 250 were walked. Look inside `json.data` for the
executions. `Older Than Cutoff` reporting 0 is correct when nothing is older
than KEEP_DAYS.

### Pagination, if it ever needs rebuilding
The working parameter carries **only `name` and `value`** - no `type`,
and the block has no `paginationMode`. n8n omits both when they are at
their defaults (qs, update-a-parameter). Writing `"type": "query"` or
`"type": "qs"` into the JSON by hand makes the node fail validation with
"Parameter type must be one of: body, headers, qs" - selecting Query in
the UI *removes* the field. Copy this node rather than hand-writing it.

### Credential
Header Auth - name `X-N8N-API-KEY`, value = an n8n API key, key only.

## Nightly execution prune

n8n stores the full data of every execution - about 250 KB per Jessie turn.
On 2026-09-02 and again on 2026-09-03 the SQLite database reached roughly
750 MB across 4,161 executions and **both Jessie and Posty stopped receiving
Slack events**. Toggling the workflows active did nothing, many times over.
Deleting 3,781 old executions brought both back.

Runs 04:00 Asia/Manila, off-peak, because the deletes hit the same SQLite
file a booking would be writing to.

### Needs one credential
Header Auth: name `X-N8N-API-KEY`, value = an n8n API key.
Select it on both HTTP nodes.

### Pagination
`type` must be `qs` (not `query`) - n8n accepts only
`body`, `headers`, `qs`. v2 shipped `query` and the node refused to run.

### Check after the first manual run
`List Executions` must return **more than 250 items**. The API caps a page at
250 and returns newest first, so without working pagination this prunes
nothing and still reports success.
